mode: Eight separate built-in imagegen generation calls, new directions; native source grids and actual vanilla menu context prepared separately

variants.name: Eye A · Stone lids
variants.subject: Homebound Eye
variants.direction: A wide horizontal almond-shaped eye. Rough dark flint chips form the upper and lower eyelids, framing pearl-green eye whites and a crimson vertical pupil. The eye shape itself is the entire silhouette, with no surrounding pebble or talisman body. It should be around twelve logical pixels wide and six high.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Minecraft 1.21.1 inventory item pixel-art direction on a genuinely transparent background.
Primary request: a completely new design, not an iteration of any earlier conversation item. Vanilla Minecraft item style, strong readable silhouette, discrete pixel clusters, natural stepped shading and small palette. Exactly a 16 by 16 logical grid enlarged with uniform crisp square cells. Leave at least one logical transparent pixel around every edge. No fine subpixel detail, blur, antialiasing, smooth vector shapes, glow halo, sparkle, decoration, letters, text, borders or inventory UI. A restrained palette around 10 to 14 colors. Distinct facets and shell ridges may contain small highlights, but avoid noisy dithering or bright outline tracing. Only one complete item. The result does not need to literally depict its crafting ingredients.

variants.subject: Homebound Eye
variants.direction: An irregular cracked flint fragment cups one side of a glossy teal-green pearl, leaving most of the pearl exposed. A tiny dark crimson pupil sits in the pearl. Asymmetric mineral and pearl silhouette, roughly eleven logical pixels wide and eleven high. Do not put the eye inside a large stone disk.

variants.direction: A large organic dark crimson pupil with a pink Spider Eye highlight, surrounded by restrained Ender Pearl green eye whites. Compact upright irregular eye-shaped silhouette, roughly ten logical pixels wide and eleven high. More organic and jewel-like than the other three directions, with a clear rough mineral base.

variants.subject: Whispering Shell
variants.direction: An open dark scallop or clam shell. A fan-shaped charcoal blue-gray upper valve with five coarse radial ridges sits above a smaller curved lower valve. variants.subject: Whispering Shell
variants.direction: A weathered short spiral shell viewed from its broken side.
